core_question: How many target-imagery identities and how many NEW native dimensions outside col(W_target) are required to recover the target imagery residual?
rationale: Both primary ROIs PERCEPTION_SUPPORT_CEILING_DOMINANT: F_FULL<0.50 for 8/8 participants in each; within-support estimator near-optimal (F_EST 0.96 ventral / 0.99 lateral); perception-derived W_target support does not contain most target imagery-residual structure.
